sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 50 for 50 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 50 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% damage reflection for 50 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 6000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 50 seconds.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 50 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Only [One and Only] Red Queen Nitocris can be used as Unlocking Potential material
